outcome: Dynamic in vivo imaging of entire primate gestation
Tracking development of major organs (heart, brain)
cohort: The participants were live pregnant common marmosets (Callithrix jacchus).
finding: The study presents the first dynamic in vivo imaging of entire primate gestation in common marmosets, creating a new staging atlas using high-resolution ultrasound.
followup_time: Entire primate gestation, from attachment until the last day before birth.
